intent: Runs a BedrockCommand's prePeek/peek/process/postProcess lifecycle against a specific SQLite db and transaction, translating thrown exceptions into HTTP-style response codes.

objects.name: BedrockCore
objects.role: extends SQLiteCore; executes a command's lifecycle methods against _db, handling timeouts/aborts/exceptions

objects.name: BedrockCore::RESULT
objects.role: outcome codes from peekCommand/processCommand (COMPLETE, SHOULD_PROCESS, NEEDS_COMMIT, NO_COMMIT_REQUIRED, SERVER_NOT_LEADING)

objects.name: BedrockCore::AutoTimer
objects.role: records one timing entry into command->timingInfo spanning its own lifetime

objects.name: AutoScopeRewrite
objects.role: RAII enable/disable of SQLite's query-rewrite hook for one process() call

misfits.why: defined at file scope in BedrockCore.cpp without `static` or an anonymous namespace, so its file-local intent relies on convention rather than being enforced

location_fit.note: fits; sits at the repo root as the execution engine beside BedrockCommand and BedrockServer

naming_quality.note: consistent; `_server` follows the `_` convention for private members
